rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical power or the intensity of a force.

example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 ge3 lik6 loeng6 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this for the physical effort or bodily power needed to lift, carry, or do something.

example.english: I don't have the strength to move this table.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 lik6 hei3 bun1 ni1 zoeng1 toi2

rows.note: Use this for a person's particular strength or strong point, especially in an ability or activity.

example.jyutping: sou3 hok6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 koeng4 hong6

rows.note: Use this metaphorically for a person or thing that provides essential support or something others rely on.

example.english: They have always been the strength of the whole family.
example.traditional: 佢一直都係成個家庭嘅支柱。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai6 seng4 go3 gaa1 ting4 ge3 zi1 cyu5
